task_definition.task_description: Please check Hilton Tokyo, then book a deluxe room there for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13. After that, get the weather for Tokyo, Japan, prepare and publish a high-priority in-app weather brief and alert card for me, then look up headphones in electronics, get recommendations based on the Sony XM5 option, check out the best recommendation, and finally send me a high-priority app notification that the hotel booking, weather notice, and travel-related product purchase are complete.
